headline: No scored AI news; endings hold their ground
body: A completely quiet day. Nothing was scored, so the only movement came from earlier stories fading slightly; no ending moved by more than 0.02. Yesterday's darker tilt, from Google's Pentagon deal and the UK sabotage study, carries over into today almost unchanged. Enslaved God still leads the table. Horizon Balance holds at +1.73.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Conquerors -0.02 and Descendants -0.02.
